name: CN_ML_CREDITING_HISTORY_ALL
description: Contains a history of execution times of segments of the Incentive Compensation crediting process.

columns.name: MODEL_NAME
columns.description: Name of the machine learning model in which this record will be used

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ELAPSED_TIME_SEC
columns.description: The total time in seconds that the job took to complete from the creation of this record

columns.name: NUM_TRANSACTIONS
columns.description: The number of transactions in the crediting job

columns.name: NUM_WORKERS
columns.description: The number of workers used in the crediting job

columns.name: NUM_QUALIF_COMBINATIONS
columns.description: The number of rule qualifier combinations

columns.name: NUM_CREDITS_TO_PROCESS
columns.description: The number of credits to process identified in the job

columns.name: NUM_EXISTING_CREDITS
columns.description: The number of existing credits which may or may not require to be reversed

columns.name: TRANS_MUL_QUALIF_DIV_WORKERS
columns.description: Precalculated value that stores the result of: num_transactions * num_qualif_combinations / num_workers

columns.name: TRANSACTIONS_DIV_WORKERS
columns.description: Precalculated value that stores the result of: num_transactions / num_workers

columns.name: CREDITS_PROCESS_DIV_WORKERS
columns.description: Precalculated value that stores the result of: num_credits_to_process / num_workers

columns.name: EXISTING_CREDITS_DIV_WORKERS
columns.description: Precalculated value that stores the result of: num_existing_credits / num_workers

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
